target.title: fix(browser): keep tab reachability retry delay abortable
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where cancelling a browser tab operation during the reachability retry delay would wait the full delay before responding to the cancellation.

`ensureBrowserRunning` used `new Promise(setTimeout)` for the 250ms retry delay between reachability probes. When the request `AbortSignal` fired during this delay, the function waited the entire `TAB_REACHABILITY_RETRY_DELAY_MS` before calling `signal.throwIfAborted()`, adding unnecessary latency to cancellation-sensitive callers.

## Why This Change Was Made

The retry delay now uses `sleepWithAbort(TAB_REACHABILITY_RETRY_DELAY_MS, signal)` which rejects immediately when the signal fires, so the caller is notified of the cancellation during the delay rather than after it.

The `sleepWithAbort` rejection is caught (`.catch(() => {}))` and the original abort reason is rethrown via `signal?.throwIfAborted()`. This preserves the caller's original error message in the response body rather than surfacing the generic `"aborted"` from `sleepWithAbort`.

Related prior art: #108561 (discord gateway READY retry abortSignal), #108408 (feishu retry abortSignal propagation).

## User Impact

Browser tab operations (close, focus, select) cancelled during the 250ms reachability retry window respond to user cancellation up to 200ms faster — dropping from ~250ms to ~50ms.

## Evidence

### Scope

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Head | `551d358f243` |
| Files | `extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/tabs.ts` (+7/−4) · `extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/proof-abort-timing.test.ts` (+166) |
| Net | +173 / −4 across 2 files |

### Production change (behavior)

```ts
// Before
await new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(resolve, RETRY_DELAY_MS); });
signal?.throwIfAborted();

// After
await sleepWithAbort(TAB_REACHABILITY_RETRY_DELAY_MS, signal).catch(() => {});
signal?.throwIfAborted();
```

### Production-route real-timer timing proof

Exercises the actual `registerBrowserTabRoutes` route handler with **real** `performance.now()` timers — not fake timers or copied helper logic. The handler processes a `/tabs/action (close)` request against a mock profile where `isReachable` returns `false`, triggering the retry delay. An abort fires 50ms into the 250ms retry window.

**BEFORE** (old code — `new Promise(setTimeout)`):

```
  === PR #109536 — Production-Route Real-Timer Proof ===
  Status:           500
  Response body:    {"error":"Error: cancelled"}
  Reachability probes: 1
  Total elapsed:    252.4ms
  Threshold:        < 150ms ✗ FAIL (expected with old code)
  ================================================
```

**AFTER** (new code — `sleepWithAbort`):

```
  === PR #109536 — Production-Route Real-Timer Proof ===
  Status:           500
  Response body:    {"error":"Error: cancelled"}
  Reachability probes: 1
  Total elapsed:    53.2ms
  Threshold:        < 150ms ✓
  ================================================
```

### Real-browser timing proof (Chrome 138 headless)

Launches a real headless Chrome instance (Chrome/138.0.7204.157) via CDP, uses the actual production `sleepWithAbort` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-env`, and measures old vs new retry timing with a real CDP endpoint verified reachable.

**OLD code (setTimeout — abort fires at 50ms, ignored for full delay):**
```
  Trial 1: 251.1ms
  Trial 2: 250.3ms
  Trial 3: 250.8ms
  → Average: 250.7ms  — waits full 250ms delay
```

**NEW code (sleepWithAbort — abort cancels immediately):**
```
  Trial 1: 50.7ms
  Trial 2: 50.6ms
  Trial 3: 51.3ms
  → Average: 50.9ms  — aborts in ~50ms
```

**Abort reason preservation:** ✓ `"tab operation cancelled by user"` propagated correctly

**Summary:** ~200ms improvement, Chrome 138 headless on Linux.

### Regression coverage

The existing fake-timer test `"does not retry or mutate after cancellation during the retry delay"` (`tabs.test.ts:324`) continues to pass. The new real-timer proof test `"aborts promptly during the retry delay (real timers)"` adds production-route coverage with actual wall-clock timing guarantees.

### Local gates (touched surface)

| Gate | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unit | `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/` | **23 passed** / 2 files |

---

AI-assisted.
